column1: # Clique leaders that may lead a clique in two compendia, each accepted for now by the issue named.
# Read by src.reports.duckdb_reports.assert_no_unexpected_duplicate_clique_leaders(): any row of the build's
# reports/duckdb/duplicate_clique_leaders.tsv fails the build unless a row here names its clique_leader and
# all of its filenames (the comma-separated compendia; order does not matter). A duplicate in fewer compendia
# than its row lists passes. Remove or narrow a row once its issue is fixed; the check logs both cases.
